problem_type: Lossy projection replaces existing storyboard editor facts
symptom: Run-backed plans expose only title and prompts and cannot retain existing editor fields. Agent prompt replacement can leave stale in-bounds skeleton offsets, making the original editor label and replace unrelated new text. Agent durationSec changes can be overwritten by the old editorial shot duration on projection.
direct_cause: Save payload and projection omit anchors, references, scenes, model choices and editorial fields.; author-only schema admitted shotKind alongside candidate taskKind, allowing contradictory media kind/model identity; patchStoryboardSubject spread the previous promptSegments even when prompt changed without new ranges.; Agent durationSec projects into parameters.duration, but editorial patching failed to update durationSec, which the original node projection treats as authoritative.
class_root: The durable editorial author body lacked a lossless typed roundtrip through the original editor. Derived text offsets must be invalidated when their source prompt changes without explicit replacement ranges.
internal_only_reason: Existing internal editor and generation owner determine this representation.
invariants: generationPlan.editorial owns the complete authored StoryboardPlan; generation candidates, sealed contracts and jobs retain their execution snapshot identities.
All original editor facts round-trip atomically through editorial, without rewriting execution candidates.
Source or content-token mismatches reject before writes; editing after submission preserves approved execution contracts and job records.
Agent author-only envelope excludes candidate-derived shotKind, just as it excludes prompt/model; taskKind determines media kind
Agent prompt changes without explicit new promptSegments invalidate old offsets; identical prompt and unrelated patches retain them, and explicit replacement ranges remain authoritative.

Agent numeric parameters.duration updates a shot durationSec unless explicit storyboard.durationSec is provided; explicit author duration has the same precedence as creation. Anchors never acquire shot-only durationSec. Parameter maps retain their existing replacement contract.

prevention.invariant: The complete editorial StoryboardPlan is the author body; candidate records remain execution snapshots, not a competing editable projection.
prevention.failure_mode: Reject malformed identities, duplicate stable subjects and stale source/content tokens; never mutate approved execution while saving a later editable revision.
prevention.strategy: Persist complete original editorial plan in the Run owner; retain approved generation candidates as immutable execution facts and use original storyboard runner for later work. Shared Agent editorial prompt patches invalidate dependent offsets before persistence/rendering; no alternate editor or prompt owner. Map Agent duration patches back to the original author duration owner before the original runner projects node metadata; keep existing parameter replacement semantics.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace narrow title/prompt save payload, without keeping parallel editor owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Internal representation invariant; no third-party runtime behavior changes.

migration: No stored migration; old generation candidates project only known facts, stable existing shot IDs are retained.
residual_risks: Real Electron editor/reopen acceptance remains separate from controlled repository tests.
Unresolved authored reference URLs must resolve before generation; persistence does not imply execution readiness.

invariant_owner_layer.rationale: The existing durable command owner enforces full editorial saves independently from execution state.
